seo_title: Maybank Case Study: Singapore Bank Content | SOMIN
description: SOMIN compared Maybank, CIMB, Citi, HSBC and UOB content in Singapore, mapping 5 audience segments, 6 pain points and the moments money worries peak.
h1: Maybank and 4 rivals lead with community, but money fears stall decisions
lede: SOMIN read social and ad library content from Maybank, CIMB, Citi, HSBC and UOB. Community Support was the top interest, identified 1,815 times, and the content formed 5 segments and 6 pain points.
meta_line: A SOMIN brand briefing · 2022 to 2024 · Singapore

challenge.title: Maybank against 4 Singapore banks on posts and ads
challenge.body: The study asked who these banks target, which pain points they address and which moments a brand could use, working from sparse, capped data.

approach.title: From 10 top interests to personas, moments and stories
points: Sized segments and pain points by posts and engagement.
Planned moments for one pain point.
Wrote story-based insights for one segment.

findings_title: Community interest, ad-heavy rivals and personal-finance fears

findings.title: Community tops the interest list
findings.body: Community Support (1,815) leads Savings (1,570), Travel (1,240) and Loyalty Programs (1,147). Finance is fifth at 827.

findings.title: UOB and HSBC lean on ads
findings.body: UOB led with 593 posts and 955 ads, HSBC ran 757 ads to 88 posts, and Maybank had 520 posts and 244 ads.

findings.title: Personal finance is the pressure point
findings.body: Navigating Personal Finance Challenge covers money management, low financial literacy and economic uncertainty, linked to fear of financial insecurity and the desire for instant gratification.

delivered.title: Maybank's 5 segments, 6 pain points and moment plans
points: Segments from Financial Stability Seeker to Community-Minded Advocate for Connection and Belonging
Pain points such as financial scams and vulnerabilities in banking, and travel risks and financial concerns
Broad and micro moments, each with an addressable tension
Sociological and psychological reasons, each tied to an applied theory
An imagined character and two sample stories

quote.text: Fear is a shackle; knowledge is the key

outcome.title: Maybank can answer money fears with knowledge
outcome.body: Answer fear of financial insecurity with understanding and connection, timed to micro moments such as a month-end balance check, a pay rise or an unexpected bill.

faq.q: Which banks were in the Maybank study?
faq.a: Maybank, CIMB, Citi, HSBC and UOB, on Instagram, Facebook and ad library content from 2022 to 2024.

faq.q: What are broad and micro moments?
faq.a: Broad moments are occasions such as festive seasons or property fairs. Micro moments are instants such as late fees on a credit card bill, each with a tension and the consumer's thought.

faq.q: Is the story character a real customer?
faq.a: No. SOMIN imagines one for a segment and adds a pain point and a psychological reason.
